# PandaCodeGen

> PandaCodeGen builds custom Next.js websites and e-commerce stores for businesses frustrated with slow WordPress sites and expensive templates. We guarantee 95-100/100 Google PageSpeed on every build.

## Services
- [WordPress Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/wordpress-migration): Migrate from WordPress to a custom-coded Next.js site with sub-second load times
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/ecommerce): Custom Shopify headless storefronts and e-commerce platforms
- [Custom Engineering](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/custom-engineering): SaaS dashboards, web applications, and custom development
- [WooCommerce Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/woocommerce): Move from WooCommerce to headless Shopify or custom solutions
- [Wix Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/wix): Escape Wix limitations with a custom-coded site
- [Squarespace Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/squarespace): Migrate from Squarespace to Next.js
- [Webflow Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/webflow): Move from Webflow to custom code
- [GoHighLevel Migration](https://www.pandacodegen.com/services/gohighlevel): Migrate from GoHighLevel to custom Next.js
